# Third-party software

Built on free and open-source software only (no paid packs or plans). Full license texts ship with the code where noted.

## THREE.JS 0.186.1 — MIT
3D engine behind the Studio office and the Crew character viewer. Vendored with its license in vendor/three/. © three.js authors. [threejs.org](https://threejs.org)

## KENNEY MINI CHARACTERS 1.0 + FURNITURE KIT 2.0 — CC0
Crew avatars and office furniture. Public-domain dedication, no attribution required (credited here anyway). © Kenney (kenney.nl). [Mini Characters](https://kenney.nl/assets/mini-characters) [Furniture Kit](https://kenney.nl/assets/furniture-kit)

## LIGHTRAG 1.5.7 — MIT
Knowledge-graph index behind the PC search (one index per PC and embedding profile). Installed from requirements.txt; CPU-only. [PyPI](https://pypi.org/project/lightrag-hku/)

## ALL-MINILM-L6-V2 (SENTENCE-TRANSFORMERS 6.2.0) — Apache-2.0
Local embedding model for the LightRAG index (384-dim vectors, CPU). The Jetson profile serves BAAI/bge-m3 over LAN instead. [Hugging Face](https://huggingface.co/sentence-transformers/all-MiniLM-L6-v2)

## PDFPLUMBER 0.11.10 — MIT
PDF text/image extraction for handbook uploads (Crew training) and order intake (consultation PDFs). Its pdfminer.six/Pillow dependencies arrive with it; everything else is the Python standard library. Tavily web search uses stdlib urllib (no package). [PyPI](https://pypi.org/project/pdfplumber/)

## PYTHON 3.11 STANDARD LIBRARY — PSF License
The backend is stdlib-only: HTTP serving and the JSON API run with no framework.

## VERIFICATION ONLY (NOT SHIPPED)
Playwright + Chromium drive the automated browser checks. Never bundled, never required to run the app.
